decisions.reason: As the flagship GIS platform with several models, D carries the firm's strategic direction and its option value is still being realized across customer projects, so dropping it would destroy the core of the portfolio.

Mobile field data capture is close to the established offer, remains in demand among public-sector and utility customers, and costs little to keep alongside the platform, so the option is still worth more than its carrying cost.

The search extension was still being actively versioned in 2019 and fits the map.apps ecosystem at low maintenance cost, although the firm's pruning of other small plugins suggests it may be merged into the platform.
